subject: Insurance
title: Credit Scores and Insurance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Credit Scores and Insurance.

hook.text: In most US states, your credit score affects your auto insurance premium.

buildup.text: Insurers use 'credit-based insurance scores'—not your exact FICO score—to predict claim likelihood.

discovery.text: The correlation is statistical, not causal. Researchers don't fully know WHY poor credit predicts more claims.

twist.text: Critics call it discriminatory. Low-income and minority drivers are disproportionately affected.

climax.text: Credit-based insurance pricing is technically accurate but ethically debated.

quiz.question: How can credit scores affect auto insurance?
options: Lower scores can significantly increase premiums
